name: Nishulk Ganavesh Yojana
benefit: Under this scheme, two sets of uniforms per student are provided through DBT/SMC to students studying in classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schools, covering all girls, all boys belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe categories, and boys from the General category belonging to BPL families.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be either a girl student, or a boy student belonging to the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or General Category BPL family. 1. The applicant must be studying in Classes 1 to 8.
